column_axis: Genomic position · genes ordered within chromosomes
row_order: Within-group Ward clustering; missing values filled with column means for ordering only.
note: The figure uses linear means of chromosome-preserving windows; full gene-level calls remain in the downloadable source matrix. Missing calls are grey. Cell ordering does not change calls. Status strip: Reference; observation low burden (<10%); observation CNV-high (>=10%).
status_annotation: Reference = source-defined reference; scRNA CNV-high = observation with cnv_fraction >= 0.10; scRNA low burden = observation with cnv_fraction < 0.10.
group_count_labels: displayed / total exported cells in the group

exports.display_layer: scRNA uses signed prevalence with square-root contrast; scATAC uses linear chromosome-preserving means; source features retained.
exports.group_layout: Minimum group height for label readability; heights do not encode population sizes.

statistics: Descriptive visualization; cells are not independent biological replicates; no significance tests.
